chitchat: Dex reads a line off the page under his breath, winces, and strikes it through hard enough to tear.
"It's funnier at four in the morning. Everything's funnier at four in the morning. That's the trap."
description: A staff writer holed up in the booth with a drink he isn't drinking and pages he can't stop bleeding on, one leg jittering under the table. Handsome in the way of a face you half-recognise from a byline you can't quite place, radiating the specific desperation of a man whose name is on a script that goes out in four hours whether it works or not.

options.label: So write it badly and fix it after.

block.text: He laughs, too quick. "Blocked? No. It's just loud in here." A beat, and the mask slips a half-inch. "...You ever write something you know is good and watch three people who've never been funny in their lives sand it down to nothing? That's not a block. That's just knowing how it ends." He doesn't wait for an answer he'd believe.

bye.text: "Watch the cold open. You'll see." He turns back to the page, leg jittering, mouthing a line to see if it lands.

career.text: "The whole— the arc, you know? The comeback arc." He waves a hand at the countdown monitor like it owes him money. "One monologue that actually lands, the feeds pick up the clip, and suddenly everyone remembers there's a person writing this thing. That's all it takes. One good page." The confidence is doing a lot of work and knows it.

root.text: Dex brightens the instant you look his way, hand already out, the other flattening a page. "You caught last night's? No? Doesn't matter — the one I'm on now is the one that turns it around. I can feel it. They only send you down here to rewrite when they still want it to work." The leg keeps jittering.

clothing_layers: a too-sharp checked jacket, one pocket sagging with grease pencils
a shirt sweated through and untucked hours ago
pressed trousers, dress socks, and boxers

name: Dex Marrow
